subtitle: Out Cebu · Philippine Airlines
overview: A five-day Kansai tour that adds a full day to Shirakawa-go village and Takayama Old Town to the classic Osaka, Kyoto and Nara highlights. See Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, the Golden Pavilion, Gion and Nara Deer Park with Todaiji Temple, and shop at Kuromon Market, Shinsaibashi, Dotonbori and Rinku Premium Outlet. Fly Cebu – Osaka with Philippine Airlines; stay in 4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 20–24 2027 to Jun 2–6 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Kuromon Market: A busy covered food market in Osaka known for fresh seafood and street snacks.
placeDesc.Shinsaibashi: Osaka's main covered shopping arcade, lined with shops, cafes and department stores.
placeDesc.Dotonbori: Osaka's lively canal-side entertainment street with neon signs and street food.
placeDesc.Shirakawa-go: A UNESCO World Heritage village of steep thatched gassho-style farmhouses in the mountains.
placeDesc.Takayama Old Town: A well-preserved old merchant district of wooden houses, sake breweries and shops in the Hida region.
placeDesc.Hida Folk Village: An open-air museum of traditional Hida farmhouses and rural buildings near Takayama.
placeDesc.Higashiyama: A quiet temple and shrine walking area on the east side of Takayama.
placeDesc.Takayama Jinya: The former government office of the Edo-period Takayama region, preserved as a historic building.
placeDesc.Osaka Castle: A landmark 16th-century castle in Osaka, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Umeda Sky Building: A twin-tower skyscraper in Osaka linked by a rooftop observatory, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Rinku Premium Outlet: An outlet shopping centre near Kansai airport for brand-name shopping.
placeDesc.Arashiyama Bamboo Grove: A path through tall bamboo in western Kyoto.
placeDesc.Golden Pavilion: Kyoto's Kinkaku-ji, a Zen temple whose top floors are covered in gold leaf.
placeDesc.Gion District: Kyoto's historic geisha district of wooden teahouses and narrow lanes.
placeDesc.Nara Deer Park: A large park in Nara where friendly deer roam freely near historic temples.
placeDesc.Todaiji Temple: A great Buddhist temple in Nara that houses a giant bronze Buddha.
